summary: Synergy Empire Ltd filed an 8-K/A disclosing the completion of its acquisition of all 10,000,000 outstanding shares of Meluha Therapeutics Berhad, a Malaysian company, via a Stock Purchase Agreement executed July 29, 2024. The filing does not state the purchase price, per-share value, premium, or consideration type. The board's recommendation and advisors are not named. No regulatory clock or break fee is mentioned. The acquisition gives Synergy 100% ownership of Meluha. Watch for future filings revealing deal terms and integration risks; the lack of price details limits risk-arb assessment.
